machine.name: Fix a bug, prove it
machine.purpose: Fix a cart total that ignores quantity. Deliver a focused patch and a regression report, with actual before/after test results.

states.name: Reproduce the bug
states.description: Read sample/bug-report.md. Run sample/cart.test.mjs with node --test and save the failing output in artifacts/before.tap.

qualityConditions.text: The supplied quantity example fails with the observed and expected totals recorded.

states.toolGuidance: Run tests in the task workspace. Preserve the failing assertion and its input.

strategies.during: Use the host agent and record concise evidence in the task workspace.
strategies.onFailure: Record the concrete gap; do not mark it as passed.
strategies.onUncertain: Keep this state and ask for the missing information.
